title: Weather disruption muddies Q4 sales
desc: Thailand's floods are expected to slightly affect domestic car sales in the fourth quarter as consumers delay purchases and dealerships face delivery disruptions, according to Mazda Sales (Thailand).
title_cn: 泰国洪灾冲击第四季度车市 购车延期交付受阻
summary_cn: 泰国近期洪灾预计将对第四季度国内汽车销售造成轻微影响。消费者因灾情延迟购车计划，汽车经销商面临交付延误问题。根据泰国马自达销售公司预测，灾害天气状况将持续对车市购销活动构成压力。
desc_original: Thailand's floods are expected to slightly affect domestic car sales in the fourth quarter as consumers delay purchases and dealerships face delivery disruptions, according to Mazda Sales (Thailand).

title: Draft law offers novel incentives
desc: The Revenue Department is drafting a new investment promotion law to replace the tax incentives currently provided by the Board of Investment (BoI).
title_cn: 新投资促进法草案出台 取代工业委员会税收优惠政策
summary_cn: 泰国财政部正起草新的投资促进法，拟用以替代泰国工业委员会（Board of Investment，BoI）目前实施的税收优惠政策。新法案旨在创新投资激励机制，为国内外投资者提供更优化的政策环境，进一步推动泰国经济投资吸引力。
desc_original: The Revenue Department is drafting a new investment promotion law to replace the tax incentives currently provided by the Board of Investment (BoI).

title: Analysts predict SET to reach 1,680 by year-end
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index is expected to finish at 1,680 points by year-end, supported by investment in artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its supply chain, listed-company earnings, foreign fund inflows and a recovery in the domestic economy, says the Investment Analysts Association (IAA).
title_cn: 分析师预测泰国股市年底升至1680点
summary_cn: 泰国投资分析师协会预测，证券交易所（SET）指数有望在今年年底达到1680点。市场支撑因素包括人工智能及其供应链领域的投资增加、上市公司业绩改善、外资基金持续流入以及国内经济复苏。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index is expected to finish at 1,680 points by year-end, supported by investment in artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its supply chain, listed-company earnings, foreign fund inflows and a recovery in the domestic economy, says the Investment Analysts Association (IAA).

title: Regulator beefs up cyber-resilience measures
desc: The insurance industry is reporting more complex cyberthreats powered by artificial intelligence (AI), prompting the Office of the Insurance Commission (OIC) to join hands with 67 life and non-life insurers to strengthen cyber-resilience, from prevention and response to recovery.
title_cn: 泰国保险业加强网络防护措施
summary_cn: 泰国保险业面临人工智能驱动的复杂网络威胁。保险监管委员会（OIC）联合67家寿险及产险公司，从预防、应对到恢复等全环节强化网络防护能力，提升行业网络韧性。
desc_original: The insurance industry is reporting more complex cyberthreats powered by artificial intelligence (AI), prompting the Office of the Insurance Commission (OIC) to join hands with 67 life and non-life insurers to strengthen cyber-resilience, from prevention and response to recovery.

title: Floods cloud country's high-season prospects
desc: The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is reassessing its high-season forecast, accounting for major flooding across several areas of Bangkok and the eastern region while it awaits household relief measures before offering the sector a lift.

summary_cn: 泰国旅游局正重新评估年底旺季预期收入。曼谷及东部地区遭遇严重洪灾，旅游部门等待政府家庭救济措施出台后再提振行业。洪灾对高旅游季的影响仍存不确定性。
desc_original: The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is reassessing its high-season forecast, accounting for major flooding across several areas of Bangkok and the eastern region while it awaits household relief measures before offering the sector a lift.

title: Oil Fuel Fund mulls loan options
desc: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.
title_cn: 石油燃料基金探索银行融资方案
summary_cn: 泰国石油燃料基金长期亏损，赤字已接近100亿泰铢。能源部强调向银行借贷是最后手段，基金面临严峻财务困难。政府正研究其他救助融资方案以度过难关。
desc_original: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.

title: Panel seeks to beef up flood preparedness
desc: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.
title_cn: 民营部门敦促政府加强防洪准备工作
summary_cn: 泰国民营部门正准备致函总理，敦促政府加速推进防洪准备工作。近期严重洪灾凸显国家防灾体系薄弱，业界呼吁政府采取更有力、更前瞻的防灾措施。
desc_original: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.

title: Bangkok faces submersion risk
desc: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.
title_cn: 曼谷面临沉没风险
summary_cn: 环保人士警告，若政府不能改革水资源管理系统、加强气候行动，曼谷到2050年可能有三分之一的区域被永久沉没。这涉及泰国首都的未来发展和防灾规划。
desc_original: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.

title: PP rejects 'entertainocracy' tag, insists unity intact
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut insists the party remains united despite criticism from former Future Forward Party (FFP) secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul over what he calls the rise of "entertainocracy" in politics.

title: Court rejects NBTC chief's B20m suit for defamation

title_cn: 民事法院驳回广播电视委员会主席诽谤案诉讼
summary_cn: 民事法院驳回广播电视委员会（NBTC）主席萨拉纳博士提出的2000万泰铢诽谤诉讼。法院认为四位同僚的批评与其官职责任相关，符合公众利益。此案涉及监管机构内部的问责机制。
desc_original: A civil court has dismissed a 20-million-baht lawsuit filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck against four fellow commissioners, ruling their criticisms concerned their official duties and served the public interest.

summary_cn: 「一面旗帜泰国」组织在芭提雅上空成功进行跳伞表演，飞行了面积达4303平方英尺的泰国国旗，完成了首次世界纪录任务。这是一项国家精神象征的体育创意活动。
desc_original: One Flag Thailand has completed its first world-record mission, flying a 4,303-square-foot Thai national flag over Pattaya.

title: ThaiHealth funding debate heats up
desc: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.

desc_original: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.

title: Govt moves to protect meet
desc: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

desc: Fighter jet tyre bursts on Ubon runway, diverts Bangkok flights Legacy An F-5 TH fighter jet suffered a tyre blowout while landing at Ubon Ratchathani Airport today, October 7, temporarily closing the runway and forcing some passenger flights from Bangkok to turn back . title: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues
desc: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues Legacy Flooding remains across 27 provinces and Bangkok , affecting more than 3.16 million people and leaving 52 dead as heavy rain and runoff from northern Thailand continue to worsen conditions across central and eastern regions. The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) said at 6am today, October 7, that floods were affecting 123 districts, 984 subdistricts and 7,215 villages, covering 1,154,875 households and 3,160,972 people. The affected provinces are Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Lamphun, Nan, Phayao, Tak, Nakhon Sawan, Uthai Thani, Lop Buri, Sing Buri, Chai Nat, Suphan Buri, Kanchanaburi, Ang Thong, Saraburi, Ayutthaya, Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani, Nakhon Pathom, Ratchaburi, Samut Songkhram, Phetchaburi, Nakhon Nayok, Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao, Chon Buri and Rayong, along with Bangkok. Photo via JS100 Radio Prachin Buri recorded the highest death toll, with 19 people killed and 59,934 households affected across all seven districts. Water levels there were still rising. Samut Prakan reported nine deaths and 223,346 affected households, while Pathum Thani recorded two deaths and 246,818 affected households

title: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want
desc: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want Legacy At many private hospitals in Thailand, choosing a specialist is easier than working out what your outpatient insurance will pay for. title: Around 2,000 pigs drown in Prachin Buri farm floods
desc: Around 2,000 pigs drown in Prachin Buri farm floods Legacy Around 2,000 pigs drowned after flash floods hit a large farm in Prachin Buri, prompting livestock officials to deploy more than 50 staff and heavy machinery to remove and bury the carcasses . Department of Livestock Development Director-General Chaiwat Yothakhol said on October 6 that the flooding affected a large pig farm in Mueang Prachin Buri district. Officials first moved surviving pigs out of the flooded area before beginning the carcass removal operation . High water levels have made access to the farm difficult. An initial 50 carcasses were transported for burial, with officials expecting to bury around 1,400 pigs on October 6. If no storms disrupted the operation, they expected to complete the remaining work on October 7. Photo via Nation TV More than 50 officials from the Prachin Buri Provincial Livestock Office, the Division of Veterinary Inspection and Quarantine and animal quarantine units in eastern Thailand have been deployed. The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation is also supporting the operation with five six-wheel trucks, a loader, a backhoe to dig burial pits and a flat-bottomed boat. Chaiw

title: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed
desc: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed Legacy Phuket has launched the “ Phuket Licence Lab ” to help small and medium-sized accommodation businesses overcome building and regulatory problems that have prevented many from obtaining the licences needed to operate legally . Five organisations from the professional, academic and tourism sectors signed a memorandum of understanding for the project on October 5 at Phuket City Development Company, or PKCD, in Mueang Phuket district. The project was developed because many small and medium-sized accommodation businesses in Phuket remain unable to obtain licences, often because their buildings were constructed before certain regulations came into force. Common obstacles include fire exits, fire protection systems, building setbacks and open-space requirements, urban planning rules, wastewater treatment systems and land ownership documents. These problems can affect both guest safety and the ability of operators to bring their businesses into compliance.
